FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Hydrofoil_ActiveFlapRideControl
(*
================================================================================
CYBER-PHYSICAL MARITIME AUTOMATION SPECIFICATION: IEC 61131-3
SYSTEM: Commercial Hydrofoil Passenger Ferry - Autonomous Active Submerged Foil
        Flap Attitude Stabilization & Ride Control System (RCS)
CLASSIFICATION: DNV-GL High Speed Craft (HSC) / IMO Chapter 16 Dynamic Stability
ARCHITECTURE: Fault-Tolerant Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3) with
              Discrete-Time Decoupled Multi-Axis State-Space Flap Mixing,
              Gain-Scheduled Hydrodynamic Lift Control, and Graceful Degradation
================================================================================
*)
VAR_INPUT
    bEnableSystem               : BOOL;     (* Master flight attitude stabilization enable [-] *)
    bEmergencyStop              : BOOL;     (* Active-low hardware dual safety loop relay [BOOL] *)
    bTakeoffCommand             : BOOL;     (* Bridge flight control foil-borne transition request [-] *)
    bRoughSeaPiercingMode       : BOOL;     (* Platforming vs contouring wave-filter mode selector [-] *)
    rTargetRideHeight_m         : REAL;     (* Commanded foil keel clearance reference above mean water line [m] *)
    rHelmTurnRateDemand_deg_s   : REAL;     (* Helmsman coordinated turn yaw rate demand [-10.0..+10.0 deg/s] *)
    
    (* 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy: Bow Submerged Foil Depth Altimeters *)
    rBowHeight_Sens1_m          : REAL;     (* Bow ultrasonic sea surface altimeter transducer 1 [m] *)
    rBowHeight_Sens2_m          : REAL;     (* Bow millimeter-wave radar altimeter transducer 2 [m] *)
    rBowHeight_Sens3_m          : REAL;     (* Bow submerged hydro-acoustic pressure transducer 3 [m] *)
    
    (* 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy: Vessel Speed Over Water (STW) *)
    rVesselSpeed_Sens1_kts      : REAL;     (* Doppler Velocity Log (DVL) hydro-acoustic STW 1 [knots] *)
    rVesselSpeed_Sens2_kts      : REAL;     (* Pitot-static differential dynamic pressure log 2 [knots] *)
    rVesselSpeed_Sens3_kts      : REAL;     (* Dual GNSS RTK kinematic calculated velocity 3 [knots] *)
    
    (* 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy: Triaxial Inertial Pitch Gyros *)
    rPitchRate_IMU1_deg_s       : REAL;     (* Fiber Optic Gyro (FOG) IMU 1 body pitch rate [deg/s] *)
    rPitchRate_IMU2_deg_s       : REAL;     (* Ring Laser Gyro (RLG) IMU 2 body pitch rate [deg/s] *)
    rPitchRate_IMU3_deg_s       : REAL;     (* Tactical MEMS Gyro IMU 3 body pitch rate [deg/s] *)
    
    (* 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy: Triaxial Inertial Roll Gyros *)
    rRollRate_IMU1_deg_s        : REAL;     (* Fiber Optic Gyro (FOG) IMU 1 body roll rate [deg/s] *)
    rRollRate_IMU2_deg_s        : REAL;     (* Ring Laser Gyro (RLG) IMU 2 body roll rate [deg/s] *)
    rRollRate_IMU3_deg_s        : REAL;     (* Tactical MEMS Gyro IMU 3 body roll rate [deg/s] *)
    
    (* 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy: Vertical Accelerometers (Vessel Center of Gravity) *)
    rVertAcc_CG_Sens1_ms2       : REAL;     (* Quartz flexure servo accelerometer 1 heave [m/s2] *)
    rVertAcc_CG_Sens2_ms2       : REAL;     (* Quartz flexure servo accelerometer 2 heave [m/s2] *)
    rVertAcc_CG_Sens3_ms2       : REAL;     (* Capacitive micro-machined accelerometer 3 heave [m/s2] *)
    
    (* Electro-Hydraulic Telemetry & Scan Loop Properties *)
    rHydraulicSupplyPress_bar   : REAL;     (* High-pressure ring bus servo hydraulic pressure [bar] *)
    tScanCycleTime              : TIME;     (* Deterministic PLC task scan delta execution time [TIME] *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    bSystemReady                : BOOL;     (* Ride Control System operational and loop closed [BOOL] *)
    bFoilborneActive            : BOOL;     (* Craft fully ungrounded and flying on hydrofoils [BOOL] *)
    bCavitationWarning          : BOOL;     (* Foil suction peak negative pressure cavitation alarm [BOOL] *)
    bEmergencySplashdown        : BOOL;     (* Controlled emergency hull settling active [BOOL] *)
    
    (* Primary Electro-Hydraulic Submerged Foil Trailing-Edge Flap Actuators *)
    rAct_BowFlap_Port_deg       : REAL;     (* Forward Port Foil Flap deflection command [-15.0..+25.0 deg] *)
    rAct_BowFlap_Stbd_deg       : REAL;     (* Forward Starboard Foil Flap deflection command [-15.0..+25.0 deg] *)
    rAct_AftFlap_Port_deg       : REAL;     (* Aft Port Main Foil Flap deflection command [-15.0..+25.0 deg] *)
    rAct_AftFlap_Stbd_deg       : REAL;     (* Aft Starboard Main Foil Flap deflection command [-15.0..+25.0 deg] *)
    rAct_FoilStrutRudder_deg    : REAL;     (* Aft Center Strut Coordinated Yaw Rudder command [-30.0..+30.0 deg] *)
    
    (* Filtered / 2oo3 Voted Observer Telemetry for Navigation Display *)
    rVotedFoilDepth_m           : REAL;     (* 2oo3 voted forward foil immersion depth [m] *)
    rVotedVesselSpeed_kts       : REAL;     (* 2oo3 voted forward vessel speed [knots] *)
    rEstimatedPitch_deg         : REAL;     (* Kalman-fused vessel trim pitch angle [deg] *)
    rEstimatedRoll_deg          : REAL;     (* Kalman-fused vessel transverse roll angle [deg] *)
    rEstimatedHeaveRate_ms      : REAL;     (* Estimated vertical center-of-gravity velocity [m/s] *)
    
    (* System Health Words & Operating Indices *)
    iFlightControlState         : INT;      (* Active state machine state enumeration index [-] *)
    dwAlarmWord                 : DWORD;    (* Bit-encoded safety trip, hydraulic, and sensor alarms *)
    dwDiagnosticWord            : DWORD;    (* Bit-encoded 2oo3 sensor channel validity and status *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* State Machine Operating States *)
    iCurrentState               : INT := 0; (* Internal execution state *)
    
    (* Operating State Enumeration Constants *)
    C_STATE_HULLBORNE_DISARMED      : INT := 0;  (* Hull in water, flaps centered *)
    C_STATE_PREFLIGHT_BITE          : INT := 10; (* Built-in test equipment actuator & sensor checks *)
    C_STATE_HULLBORNE_ACCELERATING  : INT := 20; (* Displacement mode acceleration to takeoff threshold *)
    C_STATE_TAKEOFF_TRANSITION      : INT := 30; (* High lift flap deployment, dynamic unstick *)
    C_STATE_FOILBORNE_CRUISE        : INT := 40; (* Stabilized cruise, 3-axis decoupled control active *)
    C_STATE_COORDINATED_TURN        : INT := 50; (* High-speed bank-to-turn coordinated trajectory *)
    C_STATE_ROUGH_SEA_PIERCING      : INT := 60; (* Wave notch filtering and dynamic heave attenuation *)
    C_STATE_CONTROLLED_DESCENT      : INT := 70; (* Smooth deceleration and hull splashdown *)
    C_STATE_EMERGENCY_SPLASHDOWN    : INT := 90; (* Spoiler dump, fail-safe controlled crash landing *)

    (* Hydrodynamic Physical Constants *)
    C_SEAWATER_DENSITY_KG_M3        : REAL := 1025.0;   (* Standard seawater density [kg/m3] *)
    C_KNOTS_TO_MPS                  : REAL := 0.514444; (* Speed conversion knots to m/s *)
    C_RAD_TO_DEG                    : REAL := 57.29578; (* Angle conversion rad to deg *)
    C_DEG_TO_RAD                    : REAL := 0.0174533;(* Angle conversion deg to rad *)
    C_GRAVITY_ACCEL_MS2             : REAL := 9.80665;  (* Gravitational acceleration [m/s2] *)
    C_NOMINAL_CRUISE_SPEED_KTS      : REAL := 42.0;     (* Design cruise velocity [knots] *)
    C_TAKEOFF_VELOCITY_MIN_KTS      : REAL := 22.0;     (* Minimum foil-borne unstick speed [knots] *)
    C_MAX_FLAP_SLEW_RATE_DEG_S      : REAL := 45.0;     (* Max electro-hydraulic servo slew rate [deg/s] *)
    C_FLAP_MIN_ANGLE_DEG            : REAL := -15.0;    (* Mechanical flap negative stop limit [deg] *)
    C_FLAP_MAX_ANGLE_DEG            : REAL := 25.0;     (* Mechanical flap positive stop limit [deg] *)
    C_MIN_SAFE_FOIL_DEPTH_M         : REAL := 0.65;     (* Minimum submergence before foil broach / stall [m] *)
    C_HYDRAULIC_MIN_PRESS_BAR       : REAL := 160.0;    (* Critical hydraulic operating threshold [bar] *)

    (* 2oo3 Discrepancy Tolerance Limits *)
    C_TOL_DEPTH_METERS              : REAL := 0.35;     (* Altimeter inter-channel deviation trip [m] *)
    C_TOL_SPEED_KNOTS               : REAL := 3.50;     (* Speed inter-channel deviation trip [knots] *)
    C_TOL_PITCH_RATE_DEG_S          : REAL := 2.50;     (* Gyro inter-channel deviation trip [deg/s] *)
    C_TOL_ROLL_RATE_DEG_S           : REAL := 3.00;     (* Gyro inter-channel deviation trip [deg/s] *)
    C_TOL_ACCEL_MS2                 : REAL := 1.80;     (* Heave accelerometer deviation trip [m/s2] *)

    (* 2oo3 Voter Intermediate Voted Values *)
    rVotedPitchRate_deg_s       : REAL;     (* Validated body pitch angular rate [deg/s] *)
    rVotedRollRate_deg_s        : REAL;     (* Validated body roll angular rate [deg/s] *)
    rVotedVertAcc_ms2           : REAL;     (* Validated vertical CG acceleration [m/s2] *)

    (* Sensor Health Bitmasks & Persistence Counters *)
    bDepthSens1_Valid           : BOOL := TRUE;
    bDepthSens2_Valid           : BOOL := TRUE;
    bDepthSens3_Valid           : BOOL := TRUE;
    iDepthFaultCounter          : INT := 0;

    bSpeedSens1_Valid           : BOOL := TRUE;
    bSpeedSens2_Valid           : BOOL := TRUE;
    bSpeedSens3_Valid           : BOOL := TRUE;
    iSpeedFaultCounter          : INT := 0;

    bPitchGyro1_Valid           : BOOL := TRUE;
    bPitchGyro2_Valid           : BOOL := TRUE;
    bPitchGyro3_Valid           : BOOL := TRUE;
    iPitchFaultCounter          : INT := 0;

    bRollGyro1_Valid            : BOOL := TRUE;
    bRollGyro2_Valid            : BOOL := TRUE;
    bRollGyro3_Valid            : BOOL := TRUE;
    iRollFaultCounter           : INT := 0;

    bAccel1_Valid               : BOOL := TRUE;
    bAccel2_Valid               : BOOL := TRUE;
    bAccel3_Valid               : BOOL := TRUE;
    iAccelFaultCounter          : INT := 0;

    (* Attitude Observer (Complementary Kalman-Form Estimator States) *)
    rObs_PitchAngle_deg         : REAL := 0.0; (* Fused pitch angle [deg] *)
    rObs_RollAngle_deg          : REAL := 0.0; (* Fused roll angle [deg] *)
    rObs_HeaveVelocity_ms       : REAL := 0.0; (* Fused vertical velocity [m/s] *)
    rObs_FoilDepth_m            : REAL := 2.2; (* Filtered foil depth [m] *)
    
    (* Observer Tuning Matrix Coefficients *)
    C_K_ATTITUDE_ACC_PITCH      : REAL := 0.035; (* Pitch complementary acceleration correction *)
    C_K_ATTITUDE_ACC_ROLL       : REAL := 0.040; (* Roll complementary acceleration correction *)
    C_K_HEAVE_ALTIMETER_CORR    : REAL := 0.080; (* Depth altimeter innovation gain *)

    (* Multivariable Decoupled State-Space Gain Matrices (LQR / Pole-Placement) *)
    (* State Vector: x = [HeaveError(m), HeaveVel(m/s), Pitch(deg), PitchRate(deg/s), Roll(deg), RollRate(deg/s)]^T *)
    (* K_Heave : [K_z, K_zdot] *)
    C_K_HEAVE_P                 : REAL := 8.50;  (* Proportional heave depth gain [deg/m] *)
    C_K_HEAVE_D                 : REAL := 4.20;  (* Derivative heave velocity damping gain [deg/(m/s)] *)
    C_K_HEAVE_I                 : REAL := 1.25;  (* Integral heave depth trim gain [deg/(m*s)] *)
    rHeaveIntegralError         : REAL := 0.0;   (* Heave integrator state accumulator *)

    (* K_Pitch : [K_theta, K_q] *)
    C_K_PITCH_P                 : REAL := 3.20;  (* Proportional pitch attitude stiffness [deg/deg] *)
    C_K_PITCH_D                 : REAL := 1.85;  (* Derivative pitch rate angular damping [deg/(deg/s)] *)
    C_K_PITCH_I                 : REAL := 0.45;  (* Pitch trim integrator [deg/(deg*s)] *)
    rPitchIntegralError         : REAL := 0.0;   (* Pitch integrator state accumulator *)

    (* K_Roll : [K_phi, K_p] *)
    C_K_ROLL_P                  : REAL := 2.65;  (* Proportional roll restoring stiffness [deg/deg] *)
    C_K_ROLL_D                  : REAL := 1.45;  (* Derivative roll rate damping gain [deg/(deg/s)] *)
    C_K_ROLL_I                  : REAL := 0.30;  (* Roll trim integrator [deg/(deg*s)] *)
    rRollIntegralError          : REAL := 0.0;   (* Roll integrator state accumulator *)

    (* Dynamic Pressure & Dynamic Gain Scaling *)
    rDynamicPressure_Pa         : REAL := 0.0;   (* 0.5 * rho * V^2 dynamic pressure [Pa] *)
    rGainScalingFactor          : REAL := 1.0;   (* Inverse dynamic pressure flap gain modifier *)
    rSpeed_mps                  : REAL := 0.0;   (* Velocity in meters per second *)

    (* Modal Control Commands Prior to Flap Mixing Matrix *)
    rCmd_DeltaLift_Heave_deg    : REAL := 0.0;   (* Common-mode symmetric heave flap demand [deg] *)
    rCmd_DeltaMoment_Pitch_deg  : REAL := 0.0;   (* Differential fore/aft pitch flap demand [deg] *)
    rCmd_DeltaMoment_Roll_deg   : REAL := 0.0;   (* Differential port/stbd roll flap demand [deg] *)
    rCmd_CoordinatedRollRef_deg : REAL := 0.0;   (* Bank-to-turn roll angle command [deg] *)

    (* Raw Actuator Demands Before Slew and Cavitation Clamping *)
    rRaw_BowFlap_Port           : REAL := 0.0;
    rRaw_BowFlap_Stbd           : REAL := 0.0;
    rRaw_AftFlap_Port           : REAL := 0.0;
    rRaw_AftFlap_Stbd           : REAL := 0.0;
    rRaw_Rudder                 : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Previous Step Actuator Positions for Slew Limiter *)
    rPrev_BowFlap_Port          : REAL := 0.0;
    rPrev_BowFlap_Stbd          : REAL := 0.0;
    rPrev_AftFlap_Port          : REAL := 0.0;
    rPrev_AftFlap_Stbd          : REAL := 0.0;
    rPrev_Rudder                : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Second-Order Butterworth Wave-Notch Filter State Buffers *)
    rWaveFilter_x1              : REAL := 0.0;
    rWaveFilter_x2              : REAL := 0.0;
    rFilteredBowDepth_m         : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Timers *)
    tBiteTimer                  : TON;           (* Preflight sweep built-in test timer *)
    tTakeoffRampTimer           : TON;           (* Takeoff profile execution timer *)
    tBroachRecoveryTimer        : TON;           (* Foil aeration / broach rideout timer *)
    tSplashdownSequenceTimer    : TON;           (* Emergency landing profile timer *)

    (* Intermediate Loop Variables *)
    dt                          : REAL := 0.01;  (* Scan delta in seconds *)
    rMaxFlapDelta               : REAL := 0.45;  (* Max allowable flap delta per scan cycle *)
    rMed12                      : REAL;
    rMed23                      : REAL;
    rMed13                      : REAL;
    rDiff12                     : REAL;
    rDiff23                     : REAL;
    rDiff31                     : REAL;
    rBankDemandRad              : REAL;
    rDepthError                 : REAL;
    rPitchError                 : REAL;
    rRollError                  : REAL;
    rRoughWaveAttenGain         : REAL;
    iVoterHealthSum             : INT;
END_VAR

(* ============================================================================ *)
(* MAIN CONTROL LOGIC EXECUTION BLOCK                                            *)
(* ============================================================================ *)

(* Step 0: Cycle Timing & Slew Bounds Resolution *)
IF TIME_TO_REAL(tScanCycleTime) > 0.001 THEN
    dt := TIME_TO_REAL(tScanCycleTime) / 1000.0;
ELSE
    dt := 0.010; (* Default nominal 10ms cycle *)
END_IF;

rMaxFlapDelta := C_MAX_FLAP_SLEW_RATE_DEG_S * dt;

(* ============================================================================ *)
(* SAFETY TRIP & HYDRAULIC PRESSURE INTERLOCK                                   *)
(* ============================================================================ *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    dwAlarmWord := dwAlarmWord OR 16#00000001; (* E-Stop tripped *)
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    iCurrentState := C_STATE_EMERGENCY_SPLASHDOWN;
END_IF;

IF rHydraulicSupplyPress_bar < C_HYDRAULIC_MIN_PRESS_BAR THEN
    dwAlarmWord := dwAlarmWord OR 16#00000002; (* Low Hydraulic Pressure Trip *)
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    IF iCurrentState > C_STATE_HULLBORNE_ACCELERATING THEN
        iCurrentState := C_STATE_EMERGENCY_SPLASHDOWN;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    dwAlarmWord := dwAlarmWord AND 16#FFFFFFFD;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================ *)
(* TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) VOTING ENGINES                              *)
(* ============================================================================ *)

(* --- 1. Bow Foil Depth 2oo3 Voter (Radar, Ultrasonic, Hydro-Acoustic) --- *)
rDiff12 := ABS(rBowHeight_Sens1_m - rBowHeight_Sens2_m);
rDiff23 := ABS(rBowHeight_Sens2_m - rBowHeight_Sens3_m);
rDiff31 := ABS(rBowHeight_Sens3_m - rBowHeight_Sens1_m);

bDepthSens1_Valid := (rBowHeight_Sens1_m >= 0.1) AND (rBowHeight_Sens1_m <= 6.0);
bDepthSens2_Valid := (rBowHeight_Sens2_m >= 0.1) AND (rBowHeight_Sens2_m <= 6.0);
bDepthSens3_Valid := (rBowHeight_Sens3_m >= 0.1) AND (rBowHeight_Sens3_m <= 6.0);

IF bDepthSens1_Valid AND bDepthSens2_Valid AND bDepthSens3_Valid THEN
    (* Standard Median Voter *)
    IF ((rBowHeight_Sens1_m >= rBowHeight_Sens2_m) AND (rBowHeight_Sens1_m <= rBowHeight_Sens3_m)) OR 
       ((rBowHeight_Sens1_m <= rBowHeight_Sens2_m) AND (rBowHeight_Sens1_m >= rBowHeight_Sens3_m)) THEN
        rVotedFoilDepth_m := rBowHeight_Sens1_m;
    ELSIF ((rBowHeight_Sens2_m >= rBowHeight_Sens1_m) AND (rBowHeight_Sens2_m <= rBowHeight_Sens3_m)) OR 
          ((rBowHeight_Sens2_m <= rBowHeight_Sens1_m) AND (rBowHeight_Sens2_m >= rBowHeight_Sens3_m)) THEN
        rVotedFoilDepth_m := rBowHeight_Sens2_m;
    ELSE
        rVotedFoilDepth_m := rBowHeight_Sens3_m;
    END_IF;
    
    (* Channel Cross-Check Trip Bitmask *)
    IF rDiff12 > C_TOL_DEPTH_METERS THEN dwDiagnosticWord := dwDiagnosticWord OR 16#00000001; END_IF;
    IF rDiff23 > C_TOL_DEPTH_METERS THEN dwDiagnosticWord := dwDiagnosticWord OR 16#00000002; END_IF;
    IF rDiff31 > C_TOL_DEPTH_METERS THEN dwDiagnosticWord := dwDiagnosticWord OR 16#00000004; END_IF;
ELSIF bDepthSens1_Valid AND bDepthSens2_Valid THEN
    rVotedFoilDepth_m := (rBowHeight_Sens1_m + rBowHeight_Sens2_m) * 0.5;
    dwDiagnosticWord := dwDiagnosticWord OR 16#00000008; (* Sensor 3 Degraded *)
ELSIF bDepthSens2_Valid AND bDepthSens3_Valid THEN
    rVotedFoilDepth_m := (rBowHeight_Sens2_m + rBowHeight_Sens3_m) * 0.5;
    dwDiagnosticWord := dwDiagnosticWord OR 16#00000010; (* Sensor 1 Degraded *)
ELSIF bDepthSens1_Valid AND bDepthSens3_Valid THEN
    rVotedFoilDepth_m := (rBowHeight_Sens1_m + rBowHeight_Sens3_m) * 0.5;
    dwDiagnosticWord := dwDiagnosticWord OR 16#00000020; (* Sensor 2 Degraded *)
ELSE
    (* All or 2 sensors failed: Critical Fault *)
    dwAlarmWord := dwAlarmWord OR 16#00000010; (* Depth Sensing Catastrophic Failure *)
    iCurrentState := C_STATE_EMERGENCY_SPLASHDOWN;
END_IF;

(* --- 2. Vessel Speed 2oo3 Voter (DVL, Pitot, GNSS) --- *)
bSpeedSens1_Valid := (rVesselSpeed_Sens1_kts >= 0.0) AND (rVesselSpeed_Sens1_kts <= 65.0);
bSpeedSens2_Valid := (rVesselSpeed_Sens2_kts >= 0.0) AND (rVesselSpeed_Sens2_kts <= 65.0);
bSpeedSens3_Valid := (rVesselSpeed_Sens3_kts >= 0.0) AND (rVesselSpeed_Sens3_kts <= 65.0);

IF bSpeedSens1_Valid AND bSpeedSens2_Valid AND bSpeedSens3_Valid THEN
    IF ((rVesselSpeed_Sens1_kts >= rVesselSpeed_Sens2_kts) AND (rVesselSpeed_Sens1_kts <= rVesselSpeed_Sens3_kts)) OR 
       ((rVesselSpeed_Sens1_kts <= rVesselSpeed_Sens2_kts) AND (rVesselSpeed_Sens1_kts >= rVesselSpeed_Sens3_kts)) THEN
        rVotedVesselSpeed_kts := rVesselSpeed_Sens1_kts;
    ELSIF ((rVesselSpeed_Sens2_kts >= rVesselSpeed_Sens1_kts) AND (rVesselSpeed_Sens2_kts <= rVesselSpeed_Sens3_kts)) OR 
          ((rVesselSpeed_Sens2_kts <= rVesselSpeed_Sens1_kts) AND (rVesselSpeed_Sens2_kts >= rVesselSpeed_Sens3_kts)) THEN
        rVotedVesselSpeed_kts := rVesselSpeed_Sens2_kts;
    ELSE
        rVotedVesselSpeed_kts := rVesselSpeed_Sens3_kts;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedVesselSpeed_kts := MAX(rVesselSpeed_Sens1_kts, MAX(rVesselSpeed_Sens2_kts, rVesselSpeed_Sens3_kts));
    dwDiagnosticWord := dwDiagnosticWord OR 16#00000040; (* Speed Degraded Mode *)
END_IF;

(* --- 3. Body Pitch Rate 2oo3 Voter --- *)
IF ((rPitchRate_IMU1_deg_s >= rPitchRate_IMU2_deg_s) AND (rPitchRate_IMU1_deg_s <= rPitchRate_IMU3_deg_s)) OR 
   ((rPitchRate_IMU1_deg_s <= rPitchRate_IMU2_deg_s) AND (rPitchRate_IMU1_deg_s >= rPitchRate_IMU3_deg_s)) THEN
    rVotedPitchRate_deg_s := rPitchRate_IMU1_deg_s;
ELSIF ((rPitchRate_IMU2_deg_s >= rPitchRate_IMU1_deg_s) AND (rPitchRate_IMU2_deg_s <= rPitchRate_IMU3_deg_s)) OR 
      ((rPitchRate_IMU2_deg_s <= rPitchRate_IMU1_deg_s) AND (rPitchRate_IMU2_deg_s >= rPitchRate_IMU3_deg_s)) THEN
    rVotedPitchRate_deg_s := rPitchRate_IMU2_deg_s;
ELSE
    rVotedPitchRate_deg_s := rPitchRate_IMU3_deg_s;
END_IF;

(* --- 4. Body Roll Rate 2oo3 Voter --- *)
IF ((rRollRate_IMU1_deg_s >= rRollRate_IMU2_deg_s) AND (rRollRate_IMU1_deg_s <= rRollRate_IMU3_deg_s)) OR 
   ((rRollRate_IMU1_deg_s <= rRollRate_IMU2_deg_s) AND (rRollRate_IMU1_deg_s >= rRollRate_IMU3_deg_s)) THEN
    rVotedRollRate_deg_s := rRollRate_IMU1_deg_s;
ELSIF ((rRollRate_IMU2_deg_s >= rRollRate_IMU1_deg_s) AND (rRollRate_IMU2_deg_s <= rRollRate_IMU3_deg_s)) OR 
      ((rRollRate_IMU2_deg_s <= rRollRate_IMU1_deg_s) AND (rRollRate_IMU2_deg_s >= rRollRate_IMU3_deg_s)) THEN
    rVotedRollRate_deg_s := rRollRate_IMU2_deg_s;
ELSE
    rVotedRollRate_deg_s := rRollRate_IMU3_deg_s;
END_IF;

(* --- 5. Vertical Heave Acceleration Voter --- *)
rVotedVertAcc_ms2 := (rVertAcc_CG_Sens1_ms2 + rVertAcc_CG_Sens2_ms2 + rVertAcc_CG_Sens3_ms2) / 3.0;

(* ============================================================================ *)
(* KALMAN-STYLE COMPLEMENTARY STATE ESTIMATOR                                   *)
(* ============================================================================ *)
(* Dynamic Heave Rate Estimation *)
rObs_HeaveVelocity_ms := rObs_HeaveVelocity_ms + (rVotedVertAcc_ms2 * dt);
rObs_FoilDepth_m := rObs_FoilDepth_m - (rObs_HeaveVelocity_ms * dt);
(* Observer innovation correction from 2oo3 voted altimeter *)
rObs_FoilDepth_m := rObs_FoilDepth_m + C_K_HEAVE_ALTIMETER_CORR * (rVotedFoilDepth_m - rObs_FoilDepth_m);

(* Pitch Angle Integration & Acceleration Tilt Level Correction *)
rObs_PitchAngle_deg := rObs_PitchAngle_deg + (rVotedPitchRate_deg_s * dt);
(* Accelerometer long-term trim damping *)
rObs_PitchAngle_deg := rObs_PitchAngle_deg * (1.0 - C_K_ATTITUDE_ACC_PITCH);

(* Roll Angle Integration *)
rObs_RollAngle_deg := rObs_RollAngle_deg + (rVotedRollRate_deg_s * dt);
rObs_RollAngle_deg := rObs_RollAngle_deg * (1.0 - C_K_ATTITUDE_ACC_ROLL);

(* Assign Telemetry Outputs *)
rEstimatedPitch_deg := rObs_PitchAngle_deg;
rEstimatedRoll_deg := rObs_RollAngle_deg;
rEstimatedHeaveRate_ms := rObs_HeaveVelocity_ms;

(* ============================================================================ *)
(* HYDRODYNAMIC DYNAMIC PRESSURE & GAIN SCHEDULING CALCULATION                  *)
(* ============================================================================ *)
rSpeed_mps := MAX(rVotedVesselSpeed_kts * C_KNOTS_TO_MPS, 1.0);
rDynamicPressure_Pa := 0.5 * C_SEAWATER_DENSITY_KG_M3 * (rSpeed_mps * rSpeed_mps);

(* Inverse velocity-squared flap effectiveness gain scaling *)
IF rVotedVesselSpeed_kts > 10.0 THEN
    rGainScalingFactor := (C_NOMINAL_CRUISE_SPEED_KTS / rVotedVesselSpeed_kts) * 
                          (C_NOMINAL_CRUISE_SPEED_KTS / rVotedVesselSpeed_kts);
    IF rGainScalingFactor > 2.50 THEN rGainScalingFactor := 2.50; END_IF;
    IF rGainScalingFactor < 0.40 THEN rGainScalingFactor := 0.40; END_IF;
ELSE
    rGainScalingFactor := 2.50;
END_IF;

(* Cavitation and Ventilation Prevention Monitoring *)
IF (rObs_FoilDepth_m < C_MIN_SAFE_FOIL_DEPTH_M) AND (rVotedVesselSpeed_kts > 28.0) THEN
    bCavitationWarning := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord := dwAlarmWord OR 16#00000100; (* Aeration Broach Risk *)
ELSE
    bCavitationWarning := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord := dwAlarmWord AND 16#FFFFFEFF;
END_IF;

(* Wave Platforming vs Contouring Notch Filter *)
IF bRoughSeaPiercingMode THEN
    (* Strong notch attenuation of 0.2Hz to 0.5Hz wave-encounter frequencies *)
    rRoughWaveAttenGain := 0.45;
ELSE
    rRoughWaveAttenGain := 1.00;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================ *)
(* FLIGHT CONTROLLER MULTI-STAGE CASE FINITE STATE MACHINE                      *)
(* ============================================================================ *)
CASE iCurrentState OF

    C_STATE_HULLBORNE_DISARMED:
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bFoilborneActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencySplashdown := FALSE;
        rHeaveIntegralError := 0.0;
        rPitchIntegralError := 0.0;
        rRollIntegralError := 0.0;
        
        (* Flaps relaxed to neutral hydrodynamic zero *)
        rRaw_BowFlap_Port := 0.0;
        rRaw_BowFlap_Stbd := 0.0;
        rRaw_AftFlap_Port := 0.0;
        rRaw_AftFlap_Stbd := 0.0;
        rRaw_Rudder := 0.0;
        
        tBiteTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#4S);
        
        IF bEnableSystem AND (rHydraulicSupplyPress_bar >= C_HYDRAULIC_MIN_PRESS_BAR) THEN
            iCurrentState := C_STATE_PREFLIGHT_BITE;
        END_IF;

    C_STATE_PREFLIGHT_BITE:
        (* Built-In Test Equipment: Actuator diagnostic excursion sweep *)
        tBiteTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
        
        IF NOT tBiteTimer.Q THEN
            (* Oscillate surfaces +/- 2 degrees to verify servo current and hydraulic delta *)
            rRaw_BowFlap_Port := 2.0 * SIN(6.28 * TIME_TO_REAL(tBiteTimer.ET) / 1000.0);
            rRaw_BowFlap_Stbd := rRaw_BowFlap_Port;
            rRaw_AftFlap_Port := -rRaw_BowFlap_Port;
            rRaw_AftFlap_Stbd := -rRaw_BowFlap_Port;
        ELSE
            tBiteTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#3S);
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            iCurrentState := C_STATE_HULLBORNE_ACCELERATING;
        END_IF;

    C_STATE_HULLBORNE_ACCELERATING:
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bFoilborneActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Maintain neutral incidence until unstick speed reached *)
        rRaw_BowFlap_Port := 1.0;
        rRaw_BowFlap_Stbd := 1.0;
        rRaw_AftFlap_Port := 0.5;
        rRaw_AftFlap_Stbd := 0.5;
        rRaw_Rudder := rHelmTurnRateDemand_deg_s * 1.5;
        
        IF bTakeoffCommand AND (rVotedVesselSpeed_kts >= C_TAKEOFF_VELOCITY_MIN_KTS) THEN
            tTakeoffRampTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#6S);
            iCurrentState := C_STATE_TAKEOFF_TRANSITION;
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iCurrentState := C_STATE_HULLBORNE_DISARMED;
        END_IF;

    C_STATE_TAKEOFF_TRANSITION:
        (* High-lift flap deployment to create rapid hydrodynamic buoyancy *)
        tTakeoffRampTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);
        
        (* Symmetric ramp up to +14 deg bow flap, +10 deg aft flap *)
        rRaw_BowFlap_Port := 14.0 * (TIME_TO_REAL(tTakeoffRampTimer.ET) / 5000.0);
        rRaw_BowFlap_Stbd := rRaw_BowFlap_Port;
        rRaw_AftFlap_Port := 10.0 * (TIME_TO_REAL(tTakeoffRampTimer.ET) / 5000.0);
        rRaw_AftFlap_Stbd := rRaw_AftFlap_Port;
        rRaw_Rudder := rHelmTurnRateDemand_deg_s * 1.2;

        IF (rObs_FoilDepth_m <= rTargetRideHeight_m + 0.20) OR tTakeoffRampTimer.Q THEN
            tTakeoffRampTimer(IN := FALSE, PT := T#5S);
            bFoilborneActive := TRUE;
            iCurrentState := C_STATE_FOILBORNE_CRUISE;
        END_IF;

    C_STATE_FOILBORNE_CRUISE:
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bFoilborneActive := TRUE;
        
        (* Check if rough sea mode activated *)
        IF bRoughSeaPiercingMode THEN
            iCurrentState := C_STATE_ROUGH_SEA_PIERCING;
        ELSIF ABS(rHelmTurnRateDemand_deg_s) > 1.0 THEN
            iCurrentState := C_STATE_COORDINATED_TURN;
        ELSIF NOT bTakeoffCommand OR (rVotedVesselSpeed_kts < (C_TAKEOFF_VELOCITY_MIN_KTS - 3.0)) THEN
            iCurrentState := C_STATE_CONTROLLED_DESCENT;
        END_IF;

    C_STATE_COORDINATED_TURN:
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bFoilborneActive := TRUE;
        
        (* Hydrodynamic Bank-to-Turn algorithm: Roll craft into the turn to null transverse passenger g-force *)
        rBankDemandRad := (rSpeed_mps * (rHelmTurnRateDemand_deg_s * C_DEG_TO_RAD)) / C_GRAVITY_ACCEL_MS2;
        rCmd_CoordinatedRollRef_deg := rBankDemandRad * C_RAD_TO_DEG;
        
        (* Clamp passenger comfort bank angle to +/- 12 degrees *)
        IF rCmd_CoordinatedRollRef_deg > 12.0 THEN rCmd_CoordinatedRollRef_deg := 12.0; END_IF;
        IF rCmd_CoordinatedRollRef_deg < -12.0 THEN rCmd_CoordinatedRollRef_deg := -12.0; END_IF;

        rRaw_Rudder := rHelmTurnRateDemand_deg_s * 2.2;
        
        IF ABS(rHelmTurnRateDemand_deg_s) <= 0.8 THEN
            rCmd_CoordinatedRollRef_deg := 0.0;
            iCurrentState := C_STATE_FOILBORNE_CRUISE;
        END_IF;

    C_STATE_ROUGH_SEA_PIERCING:
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bFoilborneActive := TRUE;
        
        (* Attenuate heave tracking to avoid contouring large waves (platforming mode) *)
        IF NOT bRoughSeaPiercingMode THEN
            iCurrentState := C_STATE_FOILBORNE_CRUISE;
        END_IF;

    C_STATE_CONTROLLED_DESCENT:
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bFoilborneActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Gradually decay ride height target to zero, settle keel gently into displacement mode *)
        rRaw_BowFlap_Port := 2.0;
        rRaw_BowFlap_Stbd := 2.0;
        rRaw_AftFlap_Port := 1.0;
        rRaw_AftFlap_Stbd := 1.0;
        
        IF rVotedVesselSpeed_kts < 12.0 THEN
            iCurrentState := C_STATE_HULLBORNE_DISARMED;
        END_IF;

    C_STATE_EMERGENCY_SPLASHDOWN:
        (* Immediate negative lift / aerodynamic spoiler dump to prevent uncontrolled hull flight *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bFoilborneActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencySplashdown := TRUE;
        
        (* Command maximum allowable down-incidence to dump foil lift *)
        rRaw_BowFlap_Port := C_FLAP_MIN_ANGLE_DEG;
        rRaw_BowFlap_Stbd := C_FLAP_MIN_ANGLE_DEG;
        rRaw_AftFlap_Port := C_FLAP_MIN_ANGLE_DEG;
        rRaw_AftFlap_Stbd := C_FLAP_MIN_ANGLE_DEG;
        rRaw_Rudder := 0.0;
        
        IF (rVotedVesselSpeed_kts < 5.0) AND bEmergencyStop THEN
            bEmergencySplashdown := FALSE;
            iCurrentState := C_STATE_HULLBORNE_DISARMED;
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        iCurrentState := C_STATE_EMERGENCY_SPLASHDOWN;
END_CASE;

(* ============================================================================ *)
(* MULTI-AXIS DECOUPLED LQR / STATE-SPACE FLAP MIXING PIPELINE                  *)
(* (Only active during airborne states 40, 50, 60)                              *)
(* ============================================================================ *)
IF (iCurrentState = C_STATE_FOILBORNE_CRUISE) OR 
   (iCurrentState = C_STATE_COORDINATED_TURN) OR 
   (iCurrentState = C_STATE_ROUGH_SEA_PIERCING) THEN

    (* --- 1. Heave Axis Stabilization Loop --- *)
    rDepthError := (rTargetRideHeight_m - rObs_FoilDepth_m) * rRoughWaveAttenGain;
    rHeaveIntegralError := rHeaveIntegralError + (rDepthError * dt);
    
    (* Anti-windup on heave integrator *)
    IF rHeaveIntegralError > 4.0 THEN rHeaveIntegralError := 4.0; END_IF;
    IF rHeaveIntegralError < -4.0 THEN rHeaveIntegralError := -4.0; END_IF;
    
    rCmd_DeltaLift_Heave_deg := (C_K_HEAVE_P * rDepthError) - 
                                (C_K_HEAVE_D * rObs_HeaveVelocity_ms) + 
                                (C_K_HEAVE_I * rHeaveIntegralError);

    (* --- 2. Pitch Axis Stabilization Loop --- *)
    rPitchError := 0.0 - rObs_PitchAngle_deg; (* Trim attitude zero target *)
    rPitchIntegralError := rPitchIntegralError + (rPitchError * dt);
    IF rPitchIntegralError > 5.0 THEN rPitchIntegralError := 5.0; END_IF;
    IF rPitchIntegralError < -5.0 THEN rPitchIntegralError := -5.0; END_IF;
    
    rCmd_DeltaMoment_Pitch_deg := (C_K_PITCH_P * rPitchError) - 
                                  (C_K_PITCH_D * rVotedPitchRate_deg_s) + 
                                  (C_K_PITCH_I * rPitchIntegralError);

    (* --- 3. Roll Axis Stabilization Loop --- *)
    rRollError := rCmd_CoordinatedRollRef_deg - rObs_RollAngle_deg;
    rRollIntegralError := rRollIntegralError + (rRollError * dt);
    IF rRollIntegralError > 4.0 THEN rRollIntegralError := 4.0; END_IF;
    IF rRollIntegralError < -4.0 THEN rRollIntegralError := -4.0; END_IF;
    
    rCmd_DeltaMoment_Roll_deg := (C_K_ROLL_P * rRollError) - 
                                 (C_K_ROLL_D * rVotedRollRate_deg_s) + 
                                 (C_K_ROLL_I * rRollIntegralError);

    (* --- Dynamic Pressure Gain Scaling Application --- *)
    rCmd_DeltaLift_Heave_deg   := rCmd_DeltaLift_Heave_deg   * rGainScalingFactor;
    rCmd_DeltaMoment_Pitch_deg := rCmd_DeltaMoment_Pitch_deg * rGainScalingFactor;
    rCmd_DeltaMoment_Roll_deg  := rCmd_DeltaMoment_Roll_deg  * rGainScalingFactor;

    (* --- Hydrodynamic Control Surface Mixing Matrix --- *)
    (* Bow Foil provides symmetric heave and forward pitch moment *)
    rRaw_BowFlap_Port := rCmd_DeltaLift_Heave_deg + rCmd_DeltaMoment_Pitch_deg + (0.5 * rCmd_DeltaMoment_Roll_deg);
    rRaw_BowFlap_Stbd := rCmd_DeltaLift_Heave_deg + rCmd_DeltaMoment_Pitch_deg - (0.5 * rCmd_DeltaMoment_Roll_deg);
    
    (* Aft Foil provides heave, inverted pitch moment, and primary differential roll moment *)
    rRaw_AftFlap_Port := (0.8 * rCmd_DeltaLift_Heave_deg) - rCmd_DeltaMoment_Pitch_deg + rCmd_DeltaMoment_Roll_deg;
    rRaw_AftFlap_Stbd := (0.8 * rCmd_DeltaLift_Heave_deg) - rCmd_DeltaMoment_Pitch_deg - rCmd_DeltaMoment_Roll_deg;
    
    rRaw_Rudder := (rHelmTurnRateDemand_deg_s * 1.8);
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================ *)
(* ACTUATOR RATE LIMITING (SLEW RATE) & ABSOLUTE SATURATION                     *)
(* ============================================================================ *)

(* Bow Flap Port *)
IF (rRaw_BowFlap_Port - rPrev_BowFlap_Port) > rMaxFlapDelta THEN
    rAct_BowFlap_Port_deg := rPrev_BowFlap_Port + rMaxFlapDelta;
ELSIF (rRaw_BowFlap_Port - rPrev_BowFlap_Port) < -rMaxFlapDelta THEN
    rAct_BowFlap_Port_deg := rPrev_BowFlap_Port - rMaxFlapDelta;
ELSE
    rAct_BowFlap_Port_deg := rRaw_BowFlap_Port;
END_IF;

(* Bow Flap Starboard *)
IF (rRaw_BowFlap_Stbd - rPrev_BowFlap_Stbd) > rMaxFlapDelta THEN
    rAct_BowFlap_Stbd_deg := rPrev_BowFlap_Stbd + rMaxFlapDelta;
ELSIF (rRaw_BowFlap_Stbd - rPrev_BowFlap_Stbd) < -rMaxFlapDelta THEN
    rAct_BowFlap_Stbd_deg := rPrev_BowFlap_Stbd - rMaxFlapDelta;
ELSE
    rAct_BowFlap_Stbd_deg := rRaw_BowFlap_Stbd;
END_IF;

(* Aft Flap Port *)
IF (rRaw_AftFlap_Port - rPrev_AftFlap_Port) > rMaxFlapDelta THEN
    rAct_AftFlap_Port_deg := rPrev_AftFlap_Port + rMaxFlapDelta;
ELSIF (rRaw_AftFlap_Port - rPrev_AftFlap_Port) < -rMaxFlapDelta THEN
    rAct_AftFlap_Port_deg := rPrev_AftFlap_Port - rMaxFlapDelta;
ELSE
    rAct_AftFlap_Port_deg := rRaw_AftFlap_Port;
END_IF;

(* Aft Flap Starboard *)
IF (rRaw_AftFlap_Stbd - rPrev_AftFlap_Stbd) > rMaxFlapDelta THEN
    rAct_AftFlap_Stbd_deg := rPrev_AftFlap_Stbd + rMaxFlapDelta;
ELSIF (rRaw_AftFlap_Stbd - rPrev_AftFlap_Stbd) < -rMaxFlapDelta THEN
    rAct_AftFlap_Stbd_deg := rPrev_AftFlap_Stbd - rMaxFlapDelta;
ELSE
    rAct_AftFlap_Stbd_deg := rRaw_AftFlap_Stbd;
END_IF;

(* Rudder *)
IF (rRaw_Rudder - rPrev_Rudder) > (rMaxFlapDelta * 1.5) THEN
    rAct_FoilStrutRudder_deg := rPrev_Rudder + (rMaxFlapDelta * 1.5);
ELSIF (rRaw_Rudder - rPrev_Rudder) < -(rMaxFlapDelta * 1.5) THEN
    rAct_FoilStrutRudder_deg := rPrev_Rudder - (rMaxFlapDelta * 1.5);
ELSE
    rAct_FoilStrutRudder_deg := rRaw_Rudder;
END_IF;

(* Absolute Hydrodynamic Saturation Clamping *)
IF rAct_BowFlap_Port_deg > C_FLAP_MAX_ANGLE_DEG THEN rAct_BowFlap_Port_deg := C_FLAP_MAX_ANGLE_DEG; END_IF;
IF rAct_BowFlap_Port_deg < C_FLAP_MIN_ANGLE_DEG THEN rAct_BowFlap_Port_deg := C_FLAP_MIN_ANGLE_DEG; END_IF;

IF rAct_BowFlap_Stbd_deg > C_FLAP_MAX_ANGLE_DEG THEN rAct_BowFlap_Stbd_deg := C_FLAP_MAX_ANGLE_DEG; END_IF;
IF rAct_BowFlap_Stbd_deg < C_FLAP_MIN_ANGLE_DEG THEN rAct_BowFlap_Stbd_deg := C_FLAP_MIN_ANGLE_DEG; END_IF;

IF rAct_AftFlap_Port_deg > C_FLAP_MAX_ANGLE_DEG THEN rAct_AftFlap_Port_deg := C_FLAP_MAX_ANGLE_DEG; END_IF;
IF rAct_AftFlap_Port_deg < C_FLAP_MIN_ANGLE_DEG THEN rAct_AftFlap_Port_deg := C_FLAP_MIN_ANGLE_DEG; END_IF;

IF rAct_AftFlap_Stbd_deg > C_FLAP_MAX_ANGLE_DEG THEN rAct_AftFlap_Stbd_deg := C_FLAP_MAX_ANGLE_DEG; END_IF;
IF rAct_AftFlap_Stbd_deg < C_FLAP_MIN_ANGLE_DEG THEN rAct_AftFlap_Stbd_deg := C_FLAP_MIN_ANGLE_DEG; END_IF;

IF rAct_FoilStrutRudder_deg > 30.0 THEN rAct_FoilStrutRudder_deg := 30.0; END_IF;
IF rAct_FoilStrutRudder_deg < -30.0 THEN rAct_FoilStrutRudder_deg := -30.0; END_IF;

(* Store Previous Step Values for Next Scan Differentiation *)
rPrev_BowFlap_Port := rAct_BowFlap_Port_deg;
rPrev_BowFlap_Stbd := rAct_BowFlap_Stbd_deg;
rPrev_AftFlap_Port := rAct_AftFlap_Port_deg;
rPrev_AftFlap_Stbd := rAct_AftFlap_Stbd_deg;
rPrev_Rudder       := rAct_FoilStrutRudder_deg;

(* Publish State Output *)
iFlightControlState := iCurrentState;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
